scope: Read-only source audit of original159 member core/details/roles update propagation. No application changes or browser runs.

findings.trigger: Units assignment or Leave record member link opens profile; Edit profile opens Details, while Roles and aliases share the same Save changes form.
findings.accepted_write: member-workspace.ts:1200 profile form sends PUT /api/v1/admin/member-workspace/{id}; after returned DepartmentMember it calls changed(member) at1227, never notifyParent.
findings.existing_callback: main.ts:3406 onMemberWorkspaceChanged replaces global member entry, reloads /api/v1/admin/members and admin audit, and renders only activeView members.
findings.stale_dependency: Unit row at main.ts4464 reads assignment.person canonical_name/default call level; Leave row at4049 reads leave.person canonical_name/default call level. Those objects belong to previously read unitManagement/leaveRequests snapshots.
findings.lifecycle: main.ts3400 passes createDependentParentLifecycle into profile; member-workspace ProfileOperationalChange currently accepts units/leave and emits notifications only for linked cancellation963/save990.
findings.consequence: A successful profile core PUT does not currently mark the owned Unit/Leave parent for a deferred read on final profile close. An actual runtime diagnostic is required before defect acceptance.

findings.source: member-workspace.ts1115 POST member-workspace/{id}/merge returns DepartmentMember;1125 changed(member), no notifyParent.
findings.limit: Core profile PUT diagnostic does not exercise merge, linked source identity removal, or duplicate cache recovery.

findings.source: services/api.ts343 and351 compare captured authGeneration before/after reading response body.
findings.conclusion: Missing component callback generation guard alone is not evidence of a cross-account leak; shared request guard rejects stale account response first.

diagnostic.mutation_safety: Strict browser route fulfils existing PUT locally and never forwards non-GET requests. Only remaining GETs reach disposable RAM8031.

recommendations: Use the existing owned deferred parent read lifecycle; notify immediately after confirmed core response before draft/UI transformations or changed callback that could throw. Preserve payloads, roles, permission checks and cached save semantics.
Test core save, Roles Save changes and merge as distinct mutation triggers; ensure final close coalesces multiple confirmed writes and untouched cancellation performs no dependent GET.

Exercise parent GET failure with read-only retry, child post-accept markup failure, replacement profile Next/Retry, route/month/account supersession, and newer focused input retention before applying repair.
